title: Adam Mockler DISMANTLES Scott Jennings' Iran War Defense LIVE!
description:
On CNN's NewsNight, anchor Abby Phillip moderates one of the most heated panel clashes of the year as commentators go head to head over the ongoing U.S. military conflict with Iran. What begins as a discussion about public support for the war quickly escalates into a full confrontation over strategy, cost, legality, and whether the campaign has achieved anything at all.

At the center of the debate is Adam Mockler, who argues that the war has become a strategic and financial failure. He presses the panel with one central question that defines the entire segment: can anyone name a single political concession secured from the other side? Mockler points to spiking gas prices, the estimated twenty-three billion dollars in additional fuel costs shouldered by American families, and the uncomfortable reality that the enriched uranium the war was meant to eliminate reportedly still exists. His argument frames the conflict as a war of choice that has drained resources while delivering no measurable outcome.

Commentator Kat Abughazaleh sharpens the moral dimension of the debate, challenging the way the conflict has been justified and questioning the human cost, including civilian casualties. Her exchange raises pointed questions about accountability, the framing of the war, and whether the public was ever given a genuine say in the decision to escalate.
